title: FBI Photo A001
sensor_system_note: A-series — different sensor system from B-series. Small '+' reticle with horizontal tick row, NO timestamp visible, '5' scale mark only. A001-A006 are aerial terrain views (sensor pointed down at ground). A007 is the polarity-anomaly frame (sky background, bright specular target). A008 is sky background with normal dark-on-light polarity. Treat as adjacent-not-paired with B-series.

pages.image_type: grayscale targeting/reticle display image with black redaction bars
pages.description: A grayscale image resembling a weapon or surveillance targeting display showing a textured gray surface, possibly terrain. At the center is a crosshair reticle composed of a horizontal line with tick marks and a vertical line with tick marks, forming a cross. A small number '5' appears near the right side of the horizontal axis. Numerous solid black rectangular bars (redactions) are overlaid across the image at the top edge, left and right sides, and bottom area. A small dark mark appears at the bottom right corner outside the main gray frame.

observations.claim: A crosshair reticle with tick marks is centered in the image
The number '5' is visible near the right portion of the horizontal reticle line
Multiple black rectangular redaction bars overlay the image
The background is a textured gray surface

pages.reticle_style: small '+' reticle with horizontal tick row (numbered '5' mark on right). Does NOT match B-series large full-frame crosshair.
